module_summary: AXI-stream to Wishbone bridge: an FSM parses read/write request packets (header with count and address), issues Wishbone cycles, and returns responses through a skid-buffered AXI-stream output.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Main FSM: idle, header parse, read/write wishbone phases, wait for last

anchors.name: input_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input stream bytes: request type, header count/address, and write data

anchors.name: input_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input stream valid qualifying every FSM byte acceptance

anchors.name: input_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input stream ready from FSM-controlled ready register

anchors.name: output_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output stream: response type, echoed header and read data

anchors.name: output_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output stream valid from skid buffer output register

anchors.name: output_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready controlling output/temp register transfers

anchors.name: wb_adr_o
anchors.why: Wishbone address driven from incrementing address register

anchors.name: wb_stb_o
anchors.why: Wishbone strobe requesting a bus transfer

anchors.name: wb_ack_i
anchors.why: Wishbone acknowledge completing read/write cycles

anchors.name: wb_err_i
anchors.why: Wishbone error also terminates the cycle like ack

anchors.name: wb_cyc_o
anchors.why: Wishbone cycle signal asserted with strobe

anchors.name: wb_we_o
anchors.why: Write enable latched from request type; selects write vs read path

anchors.name: wb_sel_o
anchors.why: Byte select lanes built up as write bytes arrive

anchors.name: wb_dat_i
anchors.why: Wishbone read data captured into data register

anchors.name: wb_dat_o
anchors.why: Wishbone write data from assembled data register

anchors.name: ptr_reg
anchors.why: Remaining transfer word count loaded from header; ends read/write

anchors.name: count_reg
anchors.why: Header byte counter and byte offset within wishbone word

anchors.name: last_cycle_reg
anchors.why: Remembers tlast seen, deciding wait-for-last versus idle

anchors.name: addr_reg
anchors.why: Address assembled from header, incremented after each bus cycle

anchors.name: data_reg
anchors.why: Wishbone word buffer: read data split out or write bytes packed

anchors.name: output_axis_tdata_int
anchors.why: Internal output byte muxed from response code, header or read data

anchors.name: output_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Internal ready of skid buffer gating FSM read output transfers

anchors.name: temp_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp register holding byte when output stalled

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable of output register from internal datapath

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy level when FSM not idle

groups.name: Packet FSM
groups.description: Parses request type and header, sequences wishbone reads/writes and frame drop

groups.name: Header and counters
groups.description: Word count remaining and byte index/header position counters

groups.name: Wishbone master
groups.description: Address/data registers and strobe/cycle/select generation for wishbone

groups.name: Output skid buffer
groups.description: Two-register AXI-stream output buffer decoupling FSM from downstream ready

groups.name: Input stream
groups.description: AXI-stream input carrying requests, headers and write data
